actors.name: Giorgia Meloni
actors.role: Prime Minister of Italy, Leader of Fratelli d'Italia
actors.blurb: Giorgia Meloni remains a dominant figure in the news cycle due to her government's policies on migration, her strained relationship with Donald Trump, and recent controversies surrounding her public appearances, particularly at the Mediterranean Games in Taranto. Her administration's handling of EU migration pacts and internal party dynamics within Italy's right-wing coalition are also key drivers of her prominence.
